name: pepper-collection
card: Private chalets and apartments on the Arlberg, some with a butler and a private chef.
lead: A collection of private chalets and apartments in Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph on the Arlberg, for families and friends. Some sit right on the slopes; The Barn & Chalet Mimi come with a butler and a private chef.
facts: Chalet Mimi in Oberlech: ski-in and ski-out in winter, for up to 14 guests, with a butler and a private chef
The Barn in Oberlech: 1,000 m², with a 24/7 butler and a private chef
Skyfall in St. Christoph: four apartments; the two largest combine into one residence for up to 21 guests
Arla Luxury Home on the Schlegelkopf slope, for groups of 2 to 10
why: For families and groups who want a private house on the Arlberg, with the service of a hotel when they want it.
provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. Each house is provided by pepper-collection, under its terms.

residences.name: Chalet Mimi
residences.card: A warm, traditional alpine chalet in Oberlech, with wide mountain views.
residences.about: Chalet Mimi in Oberlech comes with a 24/7 butler, an in-house chef, a wine cellar and a heated outdoor hot tub facing the mountains. Besides the master suite, it has three double rooms, two of them with a connected bunk room for children. The spa has a 14 m indoor pool with a cinema screen, a bio sauna and a steam bath.

residences.name: The Barn
residences.card: A chalet in Oberlech with a "northern chic meets alpine luxury" interior and panoramic mountain views.
residences.about: The Barn in Oberlech is designed in a "northern chic meets alpine luxury" style and comes with a 24/7 butler and a private chef. Its private spa has a 14 m indoor pool, a sauna, a steam room, a gym and a treatment room. It also has a wine cellar and an entertainment room with a bar that can be used as a cinema, a games room or for private events.

residences.card: Close to the centre of Lech, with panoramic views over the village.
residences.about: The Falcon lies close to the centre of Lech, a stone's throw from the Schlosskopf chairlift, with panoramic views over the village and the surrounding mountains. It has four individually designed bedrooms, a wine cellar with a tasting area, and a spa with a hot tub and a bio sauna. Pets are welcome.

residences.ski_access: A short walk to the lifts
residences.card: A traditional alpine chalet in Lech, with an 18th-century Stube.
residences.about: Chalet Toda is a traditional alpine chalet in a quiet yet central spot in Lech, a short walk from the Rüfikopf and Schlegelkopf lifts. residences.card: An apartment house in the quiet Omesberg area, looking out to the Omeshorn; the pictures are renderings.
residences.about: ULA Signature is an apartment house in the quiet Omesberg area, about five minutes' walk from the centre of Lech. residences.card: A renovated house of six apartments in the quiet Omesberg area.

name: Hotel & Chalet Aurelio
card: A boutique hotel on the Schlegelkopf slope: ski-in, ski-out, a few minutes from the centre of Lech.
highlights: Club Chalet for up to 16 guests
lead: A boutique hotel in Lech, ski-in and ski-out, directly on the Schlegelkopf slope and a few minutes' walk from the centre. Next door, connected by an underground passage, the Club Chalet hosts up to 16 guests with a private chef and butler.
facts: 10 Top Deluxe Double Rooms and Aurelio Suites, from 55 to 110 m²
More than 1,000 m² of spa, with a 23-metre indoor pool
The Club Chalet: eight rooms for up to 16 guests, with its own spa and indoor pool
At about 1,500 m, directly on the Schlegelkopf slope
why: For guests who want to ski from the door of a small hotel, and for groups who want a chalet of their own with the hotel next door.
provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Hotel & Chalet Aurelio, under the hotel's terms.

name: Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel
card: A hotel known for its cooking, in Zug just outside Lech.

facts: 62 rooms and suites, including family suites
Heated indoor and outdoor pool and a 1,500 m² spa
Ski rental, shop and servicing in the hotel
why: For guests who plan the day around lunch and dinner as much as around the snow, and for families who want a quiet base close to the lifts.

name: Chalets in Megève
card: Twenty-two private chalets and apartments in and around Megève, for 4 to 18 guests.
lead: Private chalets and apartments in Megève: in the village, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet, for families and groups of up to 18 guests. Geneva Airport is about an hour and a quarter away.
facts: Twenty-two houses: twenty chalets and two apartments, for 4 to 18 guests
In the village centre, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet; some let you ski back to the door
Many with an indoor pool, a spa or hammam, or a cinema room
Geneva Airport about an hour and a quarter away by car
why: For families and groups who want a house of their own: one long table, one fireplace, and the village or the slopes a few minutes away.

arranges.title: Service in the house.
arranges.text: A concierge prepares the stay, and private chefs, butlers and ski instructors can be arranged on request.

provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. Each chalet is provided by its owner through our local partner in Megève; the terms of the house come with your proposal.

name: Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld
card: Sacher in the mountains: a resort with a 4,700 m² spa on the Seefeld plateau.
highlights: Signature suites with a private sauna
lead: Sacher in the mountains. A resort at 1,200 m on the Seefeld plateau, set in its own 20,000 m² natural park, and part of Sacher Hotels since 2022. Innsbruck is half an hour away.
facts: 81 rooms and suites in six categories, from 30 to 95 m²; the Signature suites have their own sauna
A 4,700 m² wellness area with an infinity sports pool and a natural bathing lake with an alpine beach
The toque-awarded restaurant Der Max, and a piece of the original Sacher-Torte
245 km of cross-country trails in the region, right from the plateau
why: For a calm week of cross-country skiing, spa days and long dinners, with gentle slopes close by and Innsbruck for a day in town.

arranges.title: The Sacher Academy For Better Aging.

arranges.small: A programme of the hotel, delivered by the hotel's physicians and therapists.

provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay and the Academy programme are provided by Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld, under the hotel's terms.

name: rocksresort
card: Apartments with a full kitchen at the valley station of the LAAX ski area.

Its apartments, from one to four bedrooms, have a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with a steam bath. We arrange the lift passes, ready to collect at the ticket desks in Flims, Laax and Falera.
facts: 248 apartments, directly at the valley station of the LAAX ski area
The LAAX gondola on the doorstep
Apartments from one to four bedrooms, for 2 to 8 guests, from 56 to 120 m²
A fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi and a heated ski locker
Bathrooms with a steam bath or a steam shower
8 restaurants, 6 bars and 9 stores in the resort
Lift passes arranged by us, ready to collect at the ticket desks in Flims, Laax and Falera
30 minutes by car from Chur, 1 hour 45 minutes from Zurich
why: For families and groups who want their own kitchen and room to spread out, and for skiers who want to step out of the door onto the gondola. The snow parks and the largest halfpipe in the world are in the same ski area.
provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The apartments are provided by rocksresort and the lift passes by LAAX, each under its own terms.

name: Kempinski Palace Engelberg
card: A Kempinski luxury hotel at the foot of the Titlis, with a Kids Club and an 880 m² spa and pool area.
ski_access: Shuttle to the cable car, 3 min
highlights: Ski school contact in the lobby
lead: A luxury hotel with Kempinski five-star service in Engelberg, the monastery village at the foot of the Titlis, with the train station 60 m from the door. Set up for families and ski days: the Kempinski Kids Club and a kids' pool, babysitting on request, a contact of the ski school in the lobby, a locker in the ski cellar for every room, and the hotel's ski shuttle to the cable car.
facts: A luxury hotel with Kempinski five-star service, at the foot of Mount Titlis
129 rooms and suites from 24 to 129 m², 112 of them with a balcony; among them five Junior Suites, four Belle Epoque Suites, the Park Suite and the Titlis Suite
The Kempinski Kids Club, a kids' pool with splash time for children, and babysitting on request
An 880 m² spa and pool area: an infinity pool facing the mountains, a jacuzzi, saunas and a steam bath
The Cattani Restaurant and The Palace Bar, both with a terrace, the Wintergarden and a cigar lounge; in-room dining around the clock
A contact of the ski school in the hotel lobby; private ski and snowboard instructors arranged in the hotel
Every room has its own locker in the ski cellar, and boots are dried for the next day
The train station 60 m away; the Titlis cable car 800 m, 10 minutes on foot or three minutes with the hotel's ski shuttle; Lucerne 36 km, Zurich Airport 101 km
A concierge around the clock, who arranges tables at restaurants in the village and around, with transfers
Sister hotel: Frutt Mountain Resort, to extend the stay

seasons_head: Winter, summer and a rainy day.
seasons_lead: What the hotel offers or arranges through its concierge, from its own activity guides.

seasons.title: In winter
items: Private ski and snowboard instructors arranged in the hotel, and lessons for children with the hotel's ski school partner
The hotel's ski shuttle from the ski cellar to the cable car, three minutes, and back after a day on the slopes
Private tours with the concierge: snowshoeing, a winter wonderland tour, fondue in the snow, a helicopter flight, and making your own Swiss souvenirs

seasons.title: In summer
items: Bike tours arranged by the hotel, with a wine-and-cheese break in an alpine cheese dairy, and a package from Engelberg to Lucerne with boat trips and a pick-up
Kayaking and rowing on Lake Trübsee in July and August, with guided tours through the concierge
An easy 2.8 km lake run from the front of the hotel to the Eugenisee and back

seasons.title: On a rainy day
items: The hotel's spa and pool, with a splash hour for children
In Engelberg: the sports park with tennis, ice skating and curling, a covered horse-drawn carriage ride, the monastery and its cheese dairy, the cinema, and the Titlis glacier grotto
Further afield: the Museum of Transport with its IMAX cinema in Lucerne, 35 minutes away, the Glacier Garden in Lucerne, 40 minutes, and the Alpamare water park, 1 hour 20 minutes
